cohort: The study participants were 108 nulliparous women who had BMI recorded and underwent POP assessments at baseline, third trimester, and 1 year postpartum.
finding: Increasing BMI 1 year postpartum was associated with increasing anterior wall descent and higher odds of having pelvic organ prolapse 1 year postpartum.
mod_finding: Trial of labor compared to unlabored cesarean delivery was independently associated with anterior vaginal wall laxity 1 year postpartum.
